items.desc: Heat, drought and storms linked to climate change are already killing millions worldwide. Researchers want global warming to be declared a global health emergency as the health harms from it escalate faster than ever.

items.title: Egypt orders closure of independent news site Mada Masr
items.titleOrig: Egypt orders closure of independent news site Mada Masr
items.desc: Editor-in-chief Lina Attalah was briefly detained and fined over licensing violations. Rights groups condemned the ruling as a major blow to press freedom in Egypt, where independent media face growing pressure.

items.title: Flavio Bolsonaro flees Brazil for US amid investigation
items.titleOrig: Flavio Bolsonaro flees Brazil for US amid investigation
items.desc: Flavio Bolsonaro, who lost to incumbent Lula in Sunday's presidential election, has reportedly fled the country. Bolsonaro, who is facing multiple corruption probes, has refused to concede.

items.title: EU proposes giving Frontex border agency new major powers
items.titleOrig: EU proposes giving Frontex border agency new major powers
items.desc: The European Commission has unveiled a new plan to give Frontex more resources to ensure the return of irregular migrants, including by supporting non-EU countries. The move comes after the tragedy in Ceuta.

items.title: Mbappe apologizes as Chinese sponsors drop him and TV broadcasts are halted over Mao dictator remark
items.titleOrig: Mbappe apologizes as Chinese sponsors drop him and TV broadcasts are halted over Mao dictator remark
items.desc: French soccer star Kylian Mbappe has apologized after apparently referring to Mao Zedong as a dictator. Chinese sponsors have dropped him, while state television has suspended Spanish league broadcasts.

items.title: Myanmar: Is the US undermining the EU's diplomatic blockade?
items.titleOrig: Myanmar: Is the US undermining the EU's diplomatic blockade?
items.desc: With the US reopening talks with Myanmar's military-backed government, and several Southeast Asian countries restarting diplomatic contacts, the EU is facing uncomfortable questions about its own boycott of the junta.

items.title: Harry Kane: Ballon d’Or for Bayern Munich striker
items.titleOrig: Harry Kane: Ballon d’Or for Bayern Munich striker
items.desc: Bayern Munich striker Harry Kane has won football's most prestigious individual prize, beating Kylian Mbappe and Lamine Yamal. Kane has developed even more in the Bundesliga despite an uneven league.

items.title: Will elections in Israel change its Iran approach?
items.titleOrig: Will elections in Israel change its Iran approach?
items.desc: As Israelis head to the polls, the country's conflict with Iran casts a long shadow over the ballot box. But any leadership changes in Israel may not be enough to shake up its grand strategy on Tehran.

items.title: Denmark's Frederiksen criticizes Finland and Norway for calling Putin without coordinating with allies, despite consultation with Ukraine
items.titleOrig: Denmark's Frederiksen criticizes Finland and Norway for calling Putin without coordinating with allies, despite consultation with Ukraine
items.desc: Finland and Norway have called Putin about ending the Ukraine war, drawing Danish criticism. The dispute highlights divisions over European engagement with Moscow ahead of planned US-led peace talks.

items.title: Jordan acknowledges civilian casualties in Syria airstrike against 'Islamic State'
items.titleOrig: Jordan acknowledges civilian casualties in Syria airstrike against 'Islamic State'
items.desc: A Jordanian government spokesman has expressed "regret" over civilian casualties in an airstrike it said was targeting "IS" militants.
